snippet.title: Apple Rabble Dazzle - Trailer
snippet.description:
A game about harvesting apples all year round through the power of dance! Pay attention to the sage's moves, when it's your turn repeat them!

Play it for free on PC:
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3506210/
- Itchio: https://bolhut.itch.io/apple-rabble-dazzle
